title: Highlights of China | A Journey Through The Land of Dragon
highlights: Uncover China’s rich heritage and modern marvels, from Shanghai’s futuristic skyline to Xi’an’s ancient wonders and Beijing’s imperial grandeur, blending history with cityscapes.
Admire the beauty of Shanghai’s Jade Buddha Temple, home to exquisite white jade Buddha statues, where the scent of incense and soft chanting create a peaceful retreat.
Walk atop the legendary Great Wall, an architectural marvel snaking across rugged mountains, offering stunning panoramic views and a journey through centuries of history.
Step into a Ming Dynasty masterpiece at Yu Garden, where classical pavilions, koi-filled ponds, and intricate rock formations transport you to a world of timeless Chinese elegance.
Experience the beauty of the Temple of Heaven, a UNESCO site where emperors once prayed for good harvests, its circular design reflecting cosmic harmony and imperial tradition.

know_before_you_go: Travelers need a Chinese visa, so apply in advance to avoid delays.
The official currency is the Chinese Yuan (CNY); exchange some cash for small purchases.
Wear comfortable shoes, as some sections including the Great Wall of China have steep steps and uneven paths.
English is limited; downloading a translation app can be helpful.
Many sites like Google and WhatsApp are restricted, so install a VPN beforehand.
Modest clothing is recommended when visiting places like the Jade Buddha Temple.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Shanghai | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to China! Upon your arrival at the Shanghai Pudong International Airport, get driven to your hotel. Post check-in, spend the rest of your day at leisure, where you can explore the city on your own. You can visit the Bund, the city’s most iconic waterfront promenade, & soak in the stunning views of the Huangpu. Also, you can dive into a treasure trove of Chinese art & history at the Shanghai Museum or indulge in shopping at Nanjing Road, one of the world's busiest shopping streets.

days.title: Half-Day Shanghai City Tour | Visit to Oriental Pearl Tower | Hungpu River Cruise Experience
days.desc: Today, embark on a Shanghai city tour & visit the Jade Buddha Temple, home to exquisite jade statues from Myanmar. Next, wander through the Yu Garden, a Ming Dynasty gem, & visit the city’s oldest Longhua Temple & Pagoda. Then, ascend the iconic Oriental Pearl Tower, a symbol of the city’s modern innovation, & enjoy panoramic views of the city. Later, get driven to Shiliupu Wharf for a memorable Huangpu River Cruise, soaking in the contrast of Pudong's modern skyscrapers & the historic Bund.

days.title: Exclusive Maglev Train Ride | Fly to Xian | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Post check-out, head to Longyang Road Station on your own. Once at the station, board Shanghai’s cutting-edge Maglev Train, the world’s fastest commercial train to the airport. Upon arrival, catch your flight to Xian, the ancient capital of China. After landing, head to your hotel on your own & check-in. Later, you can visit the vibrant Muslim Quarter & witness the traditional crafts. Also, you can witness artifacts that narrate the rich history of this city at the Shaanxi History Museum.

days.title: Xian Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, you’ll be taken to explore Xian on a sightseeing tour & visit the Museum of Qin Terra Cotta Warriors and Horses, home to over 8,000 life-sized warriors crafted to protect China’s first emperor in the afterlife. Next, explore Xi’an’s Ancient City Wall, one of the best-preserved city fortifications, & witness the iconic Xi’an Bell Tower, a stunning symbol of the city’s rich history. Also, visit the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda, a UNESCO World Heritage site that dates back to the Tang Dynasty.

items.title: Museum of qin terra cotta warriors and horses

days.title: Transfer to Beijing via Bullet Train | Day at Leisure
days.desc: In the morning, after check-out, head to Xian North and board your bullet train to Beijing. Upon arrival, head to your hotel on your own, using public transport. After check-in to your hotel, spend the rest of your day at leisure, where you can visit the Lama Temple, a Buddhist temple known for its vibrant colors and architecture. Also, you can immerse yourself in Beijing’s creative energy at the 798 Art Zone or dive into the country’s rich past at the National Museum of China.

items.title: Transfer in Bullet Train (Fuxing Hao)
items.desc: 1 X Bullet Train will be Provided

days.title: Visit to Mutianyu Great Wall & Summer Palace
days.desc: Today, get driven to visit the world-famous Mutianyu Great Wall. Upon arrival at Mutianyu, you can take a cable car or ski lift up to the Great Wall. Once there, explore various sections, including ancient watchtowers and beacon towers, while taking in panoramic views of the rugged mountains and the Wall. Later, visit the Summer Palace and learn about the legendary "Dragon Lady," Empress Dowager Cixi, and her influential life at the Palace. After an amazing day, get driven to your hotel.

items.title: Full-Day Great Wall & Summer Palace Tour, Beijing

days.title: Beijing Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Begin your day by exploring Beijing on a sightseeing tour and visiting Tiananmen Square, the world’s largest public square. Also, marvel at the imposing Monument to the People’s Heroes and the Mausoleum of Mao Zedong. Next, step into the Forbidden City, a UNESCO World Heritage site and China’s imperial palace for over 500 years. Continue with a visit to Jade Factory, where you can learn about jade’s significance in Chinese culture and visit the Temple of Heaven, an architectural masterpiece.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, get ready and check out from your hotel in Beijing. Then board your transfer to the airport for your flight back home, marking the end to your amazing China trip!
